subject.title: Windows: lstat bottleneck causes 2-3x slower performance vs Mac (59% of CPU time)

question: Should OpenClaw accept operation-scoped realpath and existing-ancestor caches inside plugin hook/skill resolution and sandbox host-path containment paths?
rationale: Current main solved the manifest-registry sub-hotspot, but the remaining proposed cache reuse sits on containment checks where cache lifetime is a maintainer security-boundary choice rather than a purely mechanical performance fix.

options.title: Accept operation-scoped containment caches
options.body: Proceed with the linked PR shape after the current head has refreshed real behavior proof, green focused checks, and containment regression coverage.

options.title: Restrict caching to metadata paths
options.body: Decline cached canonical path answers in sandbox/plugin containment checks and keep the already-merged lower-risk plugin metadata optimizations only.

options.title: Request a different cache owner
options.body: Ask for a narrower lifecycle owner or invalidation design before deciding whether to cache in these containment paths.

recommendation.title: Accept operation-scoped containment caches
recommendation.body: Proceed with the linked PR shape after the current head has refreshed real behavior proof, green focused checks, and containment regression coverage.
